@Volatile private var isRunning = false

fun startLoop() {
    if (loopThread?.isAlive == true) return
    isRunning = true

}
fun stopLoop() {

override fun run() {
    var last = System.nanoTime()
    var accumulator = 0.0  // ms since last tick
    while (isRunning) {
        val now = System.nanoTime()
        val dtMs = (now - last) / 1_000_000.0
        last = now
        if (state == RUNNING) {
            accumulator += dtMs
            while (accumulator >= tickInterval) {

                tick()

        // frame pacing

        val sleepMs = (FRAME_MS - frameTime).toLong()
        if (sleepMs > 0) SystemClock.sleep(sleepMs) else if (sleepMs < -8) Thread.yield()?
    }
}
